# SCREEN-009 - Observation editor

Linked flows: FLOW-007  
Linked requirements: REQ-007

## Purpose and hierarchy

Add or edit a dated observation with optional note and one optional app-owned photo selected through the system picker.

## States

- Create/edit content with date, note, and photo preview.
- Photo absent, selected, replaced, or removed.
- Picker permission/failure explanation that preserves text.
- Validation and local save failure with retry.
- Offline: fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Save is primary; Choose/Replace photo, Remove photo, Delete observation, and Cancel are labeled. Use standard photo, date, save, delete, and navigation icons; photo thumbnails never become unlabeled controls.

## Text layout expectations

User notes preserve entered language and line breaks. Date follows system locale. At 200% supporting/error text wraps below its field; destructive labels remain complete.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact uses a scrolling form; expanded gives the photo a bounded supporting pane. Picker use is not the only path to save. Preview has a useful description derived from localized context, not image diagnosis. Scaffold owns insets once.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard photo, date, save, delete, and back icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Empty create light/dark; note plus photo; edit; RU 200%; long note; picker failure; delete confirmation; local save error; expanded photo pane.
# SCREEN-010 - Close batch

Linked flows: FLOW-008  
Linked requirements: REQ-008

## Purpose and hierarchy

Record an explicit terminal outcome-harvested, failed, or abandoned-with date and optional outcome-specific details before freeing capacity.

## States

- Harvested: optional actual mass and note.
- Failed: optional reason and note.
- Abandoned: optional reason and note.
- Validation: invalid date or mass remains inline.
- Local save failure retains all fields; offline is fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Save outcome is primary; Cancel leaves the batch active. Outcome uses radio buttons or a connected group, never icon-only selection. Standard harvest, failed, abandoned, date, mass, and save icons supplement labels.

## Text layout expectations

Outcome consequences are plain complete sentences. Mass uses an explicit metric unit and accepts no implied forecast. At 200% choices and actions stack without clipping.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact may use a full-height form instead of a cramped dialog; expanded may use a basic modal with bounded width. Focus starts at the heading/outcome, validation is announced, and cancellation has predictable back behavior.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard harvest, failed, abandoned, date, mass, save, and close icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Each outcome light/dark; harvested with mass; RU 200%; invalid mass/date; long reason; save failure; compact full-screen and expanded modal.
# SCREEN-011 - Settings

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-009, FLOW-010, FLOW-011, FLOW-012  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-009, REQ-010, REQ-011, REQ-012

## Purpose and hierarchy

Provide stable entry points for appearance, notifications, zones, tray presets, data portability, applicable advertising privacy, crash reporting, privacy policy, and destructive reset.

## States

- Content grouped by Growing setup, Preferences, Privacy, and Data.
- Crash reporting effective/failed initialization state.
- Advertising consent row appears only while fresh applicability requires management.
- Notification permission denied summary.
- Local loading/error only where a preference write is in progress; offline does not block settings.

## Actions and iconography

Navigation rows open SCREEN-012-016 and SCREEN-014. Theme uses a choice control; Crashlytics uses an independent switch with explanatory text. Delete all data is a destructive labeled action. Standard settings-category icons have text labels.

## Text layout expectations

Each row has a concise title and optional state summary. Crashlytics copy says disabling affects future collection, not already transmitted reports. At 200% trailing switches remain aligned without squeezing titles into unusable columns.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact is one grouped list; expanded uses list-detail for selected settings destination. Switch labels expose current state, rows have unique accessible names, and keyboard focus is visible. Scaffold/navigation own safe areas once.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard theme, notification, zone, tray, backup, privacy, crash-reporting, policy, chevron, and delete icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

EN compact light/dark; RU 200%; notification denied; consent-management row shown/hidden; Crashlytics off and init-failed; expanded list-detail; destructive reset confirmation.
# SCREEN-012 - Zones

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-003, FLOW-004, FLOW-005  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-003, REQ-004, REQ-005

## Purpose and hierarchy

Manage named Light and Dark growing zones with positive integer capacity and understandable occupied/available counts.

## States

- Content list with type, capacity, occupancy, and conflicts.
- Empty setup state with Add zone.
- Add/edit validation for blank name, duplicate identity handling, invalid capacity, and capacity below real occupancy.
- Delete blocked or explained when referenced; local save failure preserves input.
- Offline: fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Add zone is primary; rows expose Edit and Delete. Capacity conflict offers reassign, increase capacity, or keep affected future batches needing resolution. Use standard light, dark/covered, capacity, add, edit, delete, and warning icons.

## Text layout expectations

Zone type is always stated in text. Occupancy reads as localized `occupied of capacity`; names wrap. Numeric validation specifies positive whole places, not area or geometry.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact navigates list to editor; expanded uses list-detail. Counters have semantic descriptions, and warnings use icon plus text. Keyboard users can reach every row action without long press or swipe.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard light, covered/dark, capacity, add, edit, delete, and warning icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Light/dark zones with occupancy; empty; add/edit; invalid capacity; referenced delete; future conflict; RU 200%; expanded list-detail; offline.
# SCREEN-013 - Tray sizes

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-004  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-004

## Purpose and hierarchy

Manage reusable metric tray-size presets as rectangular width ? length or circular diameter, without tracking empty tray inventory.

## States

- Content list grouped or labeled by shape.
- Empty setup state with Add preset.
- Add/edit validation for blank name and non-positive dimensions.
- Referenced delete confirmation explains snapshots remain intact.
- Local save error; offline fully available.

## Actions and iconography

Add preset is primary; rows expose Edit and Delete. Shape uses radio/connected selection with explicit Rectangle/Circle labels. Standard tray, rectangle, circle, add, edit, and delete icons supplement text.

## Text layout expectations

Every number includes `cm`; multiplication sign and diameter label are localized safely. Names wrap and dimensions remain readable at 200% without fixed-width fields.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact is list-to-editor; expanded is list-detail. Shape is announced by name rather than inferred from art. Numeric fields support keyboard entry and clear error associations. One scaffold owns insets.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard tray, rectangle, circle, add, edit, delete, and save icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Mixed preset list light/dark; empty; rectangle editor; circle editor; invalid values; referenced delete; RU 200%; long name; expanded list-detail.
# SCREEN-014 - Backup and restore

Linked flows: FLOW-009  
Linked requirements: REQ-009

## Purpose and hierarchy

Create a complete local backup, preview and confirm replacement restore, export history CSV, or reach destructive reset with explicit consequences.

## States

- Idle action list.
- Backup/CSV destination selection and measurable progress.
- Valid restore preview with version, date, counts, photos, and replacement warning.
- Invalid/unsupported archive error with no mutation.
- Restore/export success or failure; cancelled picker returns to idle.

## Actions and iconography

Create backup, Restore backup, Export history CSV, and Delete all data are labeled rows/buttons. Confirm restore and delete use destructive confirmation; system pickers own file browsing. Use standard backup, restore, file, table, warning, and delete icons.

## Text layout expectations

File metadata and counts wrap; technical format errors are translated into actionable copy without leaking paths unnecessarily. Replacement and no-merge behavior is stated before confirmation. Progress labels do not rely on animation alone.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact pushes restore preview as a full page; expanded uses a supporting pane. Progress is announced without excessive updates. Focus moves to preview/error heading after picker return. Safe areas are consumed once.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard backup, restore, document, table/export, warning, delete, and close icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Idle light/dark; valid preview; replacement confirmation; invalid archive; in-progress export; failed write; success; RU 200%; expanded preview; delete-all confirmation.
# SCREEN-015 - Advertising privacy

Linked flows: FLOW-010  
Linked requirements: REQ-010

## Purpose and hierarchy

Collect or manage consent only when a fresh response from the fixed privacy-region endpoint says protected-region consent is required.

## States

- First decision: neutral explanation, Accept, Decline, and Privacy policy.
- Previously accepted: withdrawal action and current policy/version context.
- Previously declined: retained state and policy link.
- Endpoint stale/unavailable: no consent guess and no ads; decision controls wait for fresh applicability.
- Policy version changed: prior choice is unresolved and a new decision is shown.

## Actions and iconography

Accept and Decline have equal clarity and neither uses deceptive prominence. Privacy policy opens the configured destination. Withdraw is explicit and confirmed only if needed to explain immediate effect. Use standard privacy, policy/link, accept, decline, and warning icons with labels.

## Text layout expectations

Copy distinguishes app consent choice from operating-system controls and avoids legal claims beyond supplied policy text. Endpoint/policy metadata is secondary. At 200%, buttons stack and full labels remain visible.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact is a full-screen decision; expanded uses a bounded supporting surface, never a tiny modal. Initial focus is on the heading, actions have equal semantic weight, and back does not imply consent. One safe-area owner applies.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard privacy, policy/link, accept, decline, withdraw, and warning icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

First decision EN/RU light/dark; RU 200%; accepted with withdrawal; declined; stale endpoint; endpoint failure; changed policy version; expanded decision surface.
# SCREEN-016 - Notifications

Linked flows: FLOW-001, FLOW-003  
Linked requirements: REQ-001, REQ-003

## Purpose and hierarchy

Configure the 09:00-local daily work summary, optional separate soak target reminder, and recover from notification permission denial without weakening Today as the source of truth.

## States

- Summary enabled/disabled with local time selection; default 09:00.
- Soak reminder enabled/disabled according to batch applicability.
- Runtime permission not requested, granted, denied, or permanently denied.
- Scheduled summary contains work / no work, where no-work means no notification.
- Scheduling error exposes recovery while in-app actions remain intact.

## Actions and iconography

Independent switches control summary and soak reminders; time picker changes summary time. Request permission and Open system settings are labeled contextual actions. Use standard notification, notification-off, time, soak, and settings icons.

## Text layout expectations

Explain best-effort target timing and that SproutPace does not request exact-alarm special access. Permission copy says Today remains current. Times use locale conventions; at 200% state summaries wrap below switches.

## Responsive, accessibility, and insets

Compact and expanded both use a bounded settings column. Switches expose state and consequence, time picker has manual entry, and permission changes are announced. Scaffold owns insets once.

## Allowed ad slots

None.

## Asset requirements

Standard notification, notification-off, time, soak, system-settings, and warning icons.

## Preview and golden matrix

Enabled at 09:00 light/dark; disabled; permission not requested/denied/permanently denied; soak applicable; schedule error; RU 200%; expanded settings; offline.

name: Analysis and test

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [master]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: analysis-and-test-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  android-quality:
    name: Android, quality, and screenshots
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@9c971963bec38e04b3d30dcc455b5382be2fdbfb # v6.3.0
        with:
          cache-provider: basic

      - name: Make Gradle wrapper executable
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Run Android and repository gates
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --stacktrace
          detekt
          :shared:domain:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:data:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:component:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:root:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:platform:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:monetization:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:compose:testAndroidHostTest
          :shared:compose:compileAndroidMain
          :shared:data:verifySqlDelightMigration
          :androidApp:assembleDebug
          :androidApp:assembleRelease
          :androidApp:bundleRelease
          koverXmlReport
          koverVerify

      - name: Verify committed Paparazzi baselines
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --stacktrace --no-configuration-cache
          :shared:compose:verifyPaparazzi

      - name: Upload quality reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: android-quality-reports
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: |
            build/reports/detekt/**
            build/reports/kover/**
            shared/*/build/test-results/**
            shared/*/build/reports/tests/**
            shared/compose/build/reports/paparazzi/**

      - name: Upload screenshot failures
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@b7c566a772e6b6bfb58ed0dc250532a479d7789f # v6
        with:
          name: paparazzi-failures
          if-no-files-found: ignore
          path: shared/compose/build/paparazzi/failures/**

  ios:
    name: iOS compile, tests, framework, and app linkage
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7

      - name: Set up JDK 21
        uses: actions/setup-java@de7274f081f381c8f8158605e0321c36c376e2e6 # v6
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "21"

      - name: Set up Gradle
        uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@9c971963bec38e04b3d30dcc455b5382be2fdbfb # v6.3.0
        with:
          cache-provider: basic

      - name: Make Gradle wrapper executable
        run: chmod +x ./gradlew

      - name: Compile and test Kotlin iOS targets
        run: >-
          ./gradlew --stacktrace
          :shared:domain:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:data:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:component:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:root:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:platform:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:monetization:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:compose:compileKotlinIosArm64
          :shared:domain:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:data:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:component:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:root:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:platform:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:monetization:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:compose:compileKotlinIosSimulatorArm64
          :shared:domain:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:data:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:component:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:root:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:platform:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:monetization:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:compose:iosSimulatorArm64Test
          :shared:compose:linkDebugFrameworkIosSimulatorArm64

      - name: Build the iOS host without signing
        run: |
          mkdir -p build/ios-ci

internal class PublicProductionFixture(
    val directory: Path,
    preferences: MapSettings = MapSettings(),
    val now: () -> Instant = { Instant.parse("2026-10-10T10:00:00Z") },
    val timeZone: () -> TimeZone = { TimeZone.UTC },
    initialScreen: ScreenId = ScreenId.TRAYS,
    mainContext: CoroutineContext = Dispatchers.Unconfined,
    decorateManager: (ScreenDataManager) -> ScreenDataManager = { it },
    decorateManagerWithSettings: ((ScreenDataManager, ProductSettings) -> ScreenDataManager)? = null,
) : AutoCloseable {
    private val databasePath = directory.resolve("workspace.db")
    private val initialize = !Files.exists(databasePath)
    private val driver = JdbcSqliteDriver("jdbc:sqlite:${databasePath.toAbsolutePath()}",
        Properties().apply { setProperty("foreign_keys", "true") }).also {
        if (initialize) SproutPaceDatabase.Schema.create(it)
    }
    val database = LocalDatabase(object : SqlDriverFactory {
        override fun create(): SqlDriver = driver
        override fun close() = Unit
    }, Dispatchers.Unconfined)
    val settings = MultiplatformProductSettings(preferences)
    val files = AndroidPrivateFileStore(directory.resolve("photos").toFile())
    val pendingPhotos = InMemoryPendingPhotoImportStore()
    val documents = PublicFileDocuments(directory.resolve("documents"))
    val reconciledSnapshots = mutableListOf<ProductSnapshot>()
    val backup: LocalBackupService = LocalBackupService(database, files, settings, Dispatchers.Unconfined,
        documents = documents, now = now,
        reminders = ReminderReconciliationPort { reconciledSnapshots += it },
        clearPendingPhotos = { pendingPhotos.clear() },
        output = LocalDataIntegrationOutput { root.resetToFirstRun() })
    val manager = ProductionScreenDataManager(database, settings,
        workspaceRepository = LocalWorkspaceRepository(database, files, Dispatchers.Unconfined),
        backupService = backup, pendingPhotos = pendingPhotos, now = now,
        today = { now().toLocalDateTime(timeZone()).date }, timeZone = timeZone)
    val lifecycle = LifecycleRegistry().apply { resume() }
    val root: AppRootComponentDefault = AppRootComponentDefault(DefaultComponentContext(lifecycle), ScreenComponentFactory(
        ScreenComponentDependencies(DefaultStoreFactory(),
            decorateManagerWithSettings?.invoke(manager, settings) ?: decorateManager(manager), mainContext)), initialScreen)
    val platformRequests = mutableListOf<PlatformActionRequest>()
    var selectedDocument = "imported"
    var exportDocument = "exported"
    var selectedPhoto = "picker-photo"
    var platformHandler = PlatformActionHandler { request, result ->
        platformRequests += request
        when (request.kind) {
            PlatformActionKind.CHOOSE_DOCUMENT -> result(selectedDocument)
            PlatformActionKind.CREATE_DOCUMENT -> result(exportDocument)
            PlatformActionKind.CHOOSE_PHOTO -> result(selectedPhoto)
            else -> Unit
        }
    }

    fun model() = root.stack.value.active.instance.model.value
    fun field(id: String) = model().fields.single { it.id.value == id }.value
    fun dispatch(action: UiAction) {
        val active = root.stack.value.active.instance
        RootActionRouter(root, active, platformHandler) { active.model.value.selectedItemId }.dispatch(action)
    }
    /** Start a fresh public screen visit, avoiding duplicate back-stack configurations. */
    fun open(screen: ScreenId, id: String? = null) {
        dispatch(UiAction.Navigate(UiScreen.TRAYS))
        if (screen != ScreenId.TRAYS) root.open(screen, id)
    }
    fun edit(fields: Map<String, String>) = fields.forEach { (id, value) -> dispatch(UiAction.EditField(id, value)) }
    fun submit(operation: String, subject: String? = null, confirm: Boolean = true) {
        dispatch(UiAction.Submit(operation, subject))
        if (confirm) root.confirmation.value.child?.instance?.confirm()
    }
    fun save(screen: ScreenId, id: String?, operation: String, fields: Map<String, String>) {
        open(screen, id)
        edit(fields)
        submit(operation)
    }
    suspend fun seed() {
        manager.execute(ScreenId.ZONES, ScreenCommand("save-zone", "zone", mapOf(
            "name" to "Shelf", "type" to "grow_light", "capacity" to "2")).newInvocation()).getOrThrow()
        manager.execute(ScreenId.TRAY_SIZES, ScreenCommand("save-tray-size", "tray", mapOf(
            "name" to "Tray", "shape" to "rectangle", "widthCm" to "20", "lengthCm" to "30")).newInvocation()).getOrThrow()
        manager.execute(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, ScreenCommand("save-batch", "batch", mapOf(
            "cultureId" to "pea", "trayId" to "tray", "substrate" to "Coco", "actualSeedMassGrams" to "12.5",
            "plannedSowDate" to "2026-10-10")).newInvocation()).getOrThrow()
    }
    override fun close() { lifecycle.destroy(); database.close(); files.close(); pendingPhotos.close() }
}

/** File-backed test host port: external exports survive private import cleanup. */
internal class PublicFileDocuments(private val directory: Path) : ArchiveDocumentPort {
    private fun path(id: String): Path {
        require(id.matches(Regex("[A-Za-z0-9._-]+")))
        return directory.resolve(if (id.startsWith("imported")) "imports" else "exports").resolve(id)
    }
    override suspend fun read(documentId: String): ByteArray? = path(documentId).takeIf(Files::exists)?.let(Files::readAllBytes)
    override suspend fun write(documentId: String, bytes: ByteArray) {
        val file = path(documentId)
        Files.createDirectories(file.parent)
        Files.write(file, bytes)
    }
    override suspend fun clearImportedArchives() {
        val imports = directory.resolve("imports")
        if (Files.exists(imports)) Files.list(imports).use { entries -> entries.forEach(Files::delete) }
    }
}

internal suspend fun withPublicWorkspace(block: suspend (Path, MapSettings) -> Unit) {
    val directory = Files.createTempDirectory("sproutpace-public-")
    try { block(directory, MapSettings()) } finally {
        Files.walk(directory).use { entries -> entries.sorted(Comparator.reverseOrder()).forEach(Files::delete) }
    }
}

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Minimal scenario-oriented delivery, direct checks and independent acceptance."""
import argparse
import json
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import lean_delivery as delivery
from vibe_protocol import ProtocolError, compute_app_spec_fingerprint, fingerprint_equal, read_json


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('project_root', type=Path)
    actions = parser.add_subparsers(dest='action', required=True)
    init = actions.add_parser('init'); init.add_argument('--app-spec', required=True)
    init.add_argument('--from-strict', action='store_true'); init.add_argument('--decision')
    actions.add_parser('status')
    note = actions.add_parser('note'); note.add_argument('text'); note.add_argument('--scenario')
    adopt = actions.add_parser('adopt-spec'); adopt.add_argument('--decision', required=True)
    check = actions.add_parser('check'); check.add_argument('--runner', choices=['command', 'gradle'], default='command')
    check.add_argument('--timeout', type=int, default=1800); check.add_argument('command', nargs=argparse.REMAINDER)
    request = actions.add_parser('audit-request'); request.add_argument('--previous', help='Prior independent request for delta review')
    audit = actions.add_parser('audit'); audit.add_argument('--request', required=True); audit.add_argument('--timeout', type=int, default=1800)
    actions.add_parser('close')
    args = parser.parse_args(); root = args.project_root.resolve()
    try:
        if args.action == 'init': result = delivery.initialize(root, args.app_spec, args.decision, args.from_strict)
        elif args.action == 'note': result = delivery.update(root, args.scenario, args.text)
        elif args.action == 'adopt-spec': result = delivery.update(root, adopt_spec=args.decision)
        elif args.action == 'check':
            argv = args.command[1:] if args.command[:1] == ['--'] else args.command
            code, result = delivery.check(root, argv, args.runner, args.timeout); print(result); return code
        elif args.action == 'audit-request': result = str(delivery.request_audit(root, args.previous))
        elif args.action == 'audit':
            executable = shutil.which('codex')
            if not executable: raise ProtocolError('Codex CLI unavailable: independent audit blocked')
            result = delivery.run_audit(root, delivery.local(root, args.request), executable, args.timeout)
        elif args.action == 'close': result = delivery.close(root)
        else:
            value = delivery.state(root)
            result = {k: value[k] for k in ('mode', 'scenarios', 'nextAction', 'auditRequest')}
            result['specCurrent'] = fingerprint_equal(value['appSpecFingerprint'], compute_app_spec_fingerprint(root / value['appSpec']))
            result['completion'] = {'locallyVerified': False, 'implementationComplete': False, 'releaseReady': False}
            if value.get('auditRequest'):
                path = delivery.local(root, value['auditRequest'])
                if path.with_name('launch.json').exists():
                    launch = read_json(path.with_name('launch.json'))
                    result['auditExecution'] = {k: launch.get(k) for k in ('executionStatus', 'exitCode', 'threadId')}
                    result['auditLog'] = str(path.with_name('stderr.log'))
                if path.with_name('audit.json').exists():
                    audit = read_json(path.with_name('audit.json'))
                    errors, completion = delivery.validate_audit(root, path, audit)
                    result.update(completion=completion, auditErrors=errors,
                                  verdict=audit.get('verdict'), findings=audit.get('findings', []))
        print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)); return 0
    except (ProtocolError, OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as exc:
        print(f'ERROR: {exc}', file=sys.stderr); return 1


if __name__ == '__main__': raise SystemExit(main())

# Lazyweb Design Improve

## CRITICAL: Output Behavior

**This skill produces FILES, not a plan.** Regardless of whether you are in plan mode
or not, ALWAYS:

1. Write the HTML report to `.lazyweb/design-improve/{screen}-{date}/report.html`
2. Download references to `.lazyweb/design-improve/{screen}-{date}/references/`
3. Do NOT create `report.md` or any other Markdown report artifact
4. Do NOT write improvement content into a plan file
5. After saving, show the user a summary of improvement ideas and tell them where the files are
6. Ask the user if the improvements look good
7. If in plan mode, exit plan mode after the user confirms
8. Suggest next steps: "You can now implement these improvements, run
   `/lazyweb-design-brainstorm` for more creative ideas, or start building."

---

Capture the current state of a design, find similar screens from the best apps,
and generate 1-5 concrete improvement ideas - each tied to a real reference.

## When to Use This

- User has an existing screen/page and wants to make it better
- User asks "how can I improve this" or "what's wrong with my design"
- User wants to compare their design against competitors

## When NOT to Use This

- User hasn't built anything yet and wants research  use `/lazyweb-design-research`
- User wants to see examples of a specific screen type  use `/lazyweb-quick-references`
- User wants creative/unconventional ideas  use `/lazyweb-design-brainstorm`

## Lazyweb MCP Setup

Use the hosted Lazyweb MCP tools at `https://www.lazyweb.com/mcp` for all Lazyweb database access.

Required MCP tools:
- `lazyweb_search` - text search over mobile and desktop screenshots
- `lazyweb_find_similar` - more results like a known Lazyweb screenshot ID
- `lazyweb_compare_image` - visual search from `image_base64` + `mime_type` or `image_url`
- `lazyweb_health` - connectivity check

These are stable public compatibility aliases. The server may also expose canonical
tools such as `search_screenshots`, `list_filters`, `vision_screenshots`, and
`metadata_screenshots`; prefer the `lazyweb_*` names in this skill.

Before searching, verify MCP is available by listing tools and running
`lazyweb_health`.

**If Lazyweb MCP is not installed or auth fails:**
Tell the user: "Lazyweb MCP is not installed. Enable the global Lazyweb plugin or
get the free setup instructions at https://www.lazyweb.com/mcp-install, paste
them into this agent, then rerun this skill. Lazyweb is free; the bearer token is
only for no-billing UI reference tools and is okay in ignored local config."
Then proceed with web research only - the skill still works, just without Lazyweb's database.

def check(root, argv, runner='command', timeout=1800):
    """Any owner can request feedback directly; Gradle uses the existing mutex."""
    if not argv:
        raise ProtocolError('check command/tasks required')
    if runner == 'gradle' and sys.platform == 'win32':
        directory = root / '.vibe/requests'
        path = directory / f'lean-check-{uuid.uuid4()}.json'
        # Machine-generated transport, not an agent-authored coverage request.
        atomic_write_json(path, {'tasks': argv, 'kind': 'integration',
            'coveredObligations': [], 'timeoutSeconds': timeout}, refuse_existing=True)
        shell = shutil.which('pwsh') or shutil.which('powershell')
        if not shell:
            raise ProtocolError('PowerShell required for serialized Windows Gradle runner')
        code, out, err, status = execute_process([shell, '-NoProfile', '-File',
            str(Path(__file__).with_name('run-gradle.ps1')), '-ProjectRoot', str(root),
            '-RequestPath', str(path)], cwd=root, timeout=timeout + 650)
        return code, (out + err).decode('utf-8', errors='replace')[-2000:]
    if runner == 'gradle':
        argv = [str(root / 'gradlew'), '--no-parallel', '--max-workers=1', *argv]
    with file_lock(root / '.vibe/jobs/command-runner.lock', timeout=600):
        path, receipt = load_script('run-check').run_check(root, argv, [], 'integration', timeout, serialized_gradle=runner == 'gradle')
    return (0 if receipt['exitCode'] == 0 and receipt['executionStatus'] == 'completed' else 1), str(path)


def request_audit(root, previous=None):
    value = state(root)
    app_root, app = spec(root, value['appSpec'])
    app_fp = compute_app_spec_fingerprint(app_root)
    if not fingerprint_equal(app_fp, value['appSpecFingerprint']):
        raise ProtocolError('AppSpec changed: adopt-spec with saved authorization first')

internal fun typedPreviewState(
    screen: UiScreen,
    variant: UiVariant = UiVariant.CONTENT,
    showAd: Boolean = false,
    scenario: ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario = when (variant) {
        UiVariant.EMPTY -> ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario.EMPTY
        UiVariant.CONFLICT -> ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario.CAPACITY_CONFLICT
        UiVariant.TEMPORARILY_UNASSIGNED -> ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario.UNASSIGNED
        UiVariant.RESTORE_PREVIEW -> ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario.RESTORE_PREVIEW
        else -> ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario.CONTENT
    },
    draft: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    permissionOverride: PermissionState? = null,
    selectedId: String? = ProductionScreenFixtures.selectedId(screen.toScreenId()),
    errorKeyOverride: String? = null,
    platformProjection: (com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.ScreenSnapshot) ->
        com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.ScreenSnapshot = { it },
): SproutPaceUiState {
    val screenId = screen.toScreenId()
    val snapshot = platformProjection(ProductionScreenFixtures.snapshot(screenId, stableId = selectedId, scenario = scenario))
    val draftValues = if (variant == UiVariant.VALIDATION_ERROR) invalidPreviewDraft(screen) + draft else draft
    val fields = snapshot.fields.map { field -> field.copy(value = draftValues[field.id.value] ?: field.value) }
    val errors = if (variant == UiVariant.VALIDATION_ERROR) {
        val operation = requireNotNull(ScreenContractRegistry.contracts.getValue(screenId).primaryOperation)
        val preparation = ScreenContractRegistry.prepareCommand(screenId, ScreenActionId(operation),
            snapshot.selectedItemId ?: fields.firstOrNull { it.id.value == "id" }?.value,
            fields.associate { it.id to it.value })
        check(preparation is CommandPreparation.Invalid)
        preparation.errors
    } else emptyMap()
    val denied = variant == UiVariant.PERMISSION_DENIED
    val permission = permissionOverride ?: if (denied) PermissionState.PERMANENTLY_DENIED else snapshot.permissionState
    val model = ScreenModel(
        screen = screenId,
        loadState = previewLoadState(variant, scenario, errorKeyOverride),
        errorKey = errorKeyOverride?.let(::TextKey) ?: when {
            scenario == ProductionScreenFixtures.Scenario.BACKUP_WRITE_FAILED -> TextKey("error_document_write_failed")
            variant == UiVariant.ERROR -> TextKey("error_backup_invalid")
            else -> null
        },
        titleKey = TextKey("screen_${screen.name.lowercase()}_title"),
        items = snapshot.items,
        selectedItemId = snapshot.selectedItemId ?: selectedId,
        plans = snapshot.plans,
        setupState = snapshot.setupState,
        detail = previewSelectedDetail(screen, selectedId, scenario),
        primaryActionKey = snapshot.primaryActionKey,
        permissionState = permission,
        conflictResolutionKeys = snapshot.conflictResolutionKeys,
        offline = snapshot.offline,
        fields = fields,
        facts = snapshot.facts.withDraftSeedRecommendation(screenId, fields, snapshot.actions),
        actions = if (screen == UiScreen.NOTIFICATIONS) snapshot.actions.filter {
            it.id.value in notificationPermissionActionIds(
                fields.any { field -> field.id.value in setOf("dailySummaryEnabled", "soakRemindersEnabled") && field.value == "true" },
                permission.previewPlatformPermission())
        } else snapshot.actions,
        validationErrors = errors,
    )
    val state = previewComponent(screen, model).model.value.toUiState().copy(
        showInlineAd = showAd,
    )
    return if (screen == UiScreen.ADVERTISING_PRIVACY) {
        state.withAdvertisingPrivacy(previewPrivacy(ConsentChoice.UNDECIDED), PREVIEW_PRIVACY_NOW)
    } else state
}

/** Regressions exercise public field edits and commands against actual SQLite, including storage reopen. */
class UiCompletenessProductionTest {
    @Test
    fun authoredTextSurvivesPublicEditorsStorageReopenAndBackup() = runTest {
        storage { url ->
            val original = Fixture(url, true).use { fixture ->
                fixture.save(ScreenId.ZONES, null, "save-zone", mapOf("name" to AUTHORED, "type" to "grow_light", "capacity" to " 2 "))
                val zone = fixture.database.snapshot().zones.single()
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, zone.name)
                fixture.save(ScreenId.TRAY_SIZES, null, "save-tray-size", mapOf("name" to AUTHORED, "shape" to "rectangle",
                    "widthCm" to " 20 ", "lengthCm" to "30"))
                val tray = fixture.database.snapshot().trayPresets.single()
                fixture.save(ScreenId.RECIPE, null, "save-recipe", mapOf("name" to AUTHORED, "substrate" to AUTHORED,
                    "stage1" to "sown", "stage1MinimumHours" to "0", "stage1MaximumHours" to "0", "stage1Guidance" to AUTHORED,
                    "stage2" to "light_growth", "stage2MinimumHours" to "24", "stage2MaximumHours" to "48", "stage2Guidance" to AUTHORED,
                    "stage3" to "ready_for_harvest", "stage3MinimumHours" to "0", "stage3MaximumHours" to "0", "stage3Guidance" to AUTHORED,
                    "stage4" to "none", "stage5" to "none"))
                val recipe = fixture.database.snapshot().recipes.single()
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, recipe.name)
                assertTrue(recipe.stages.all { it.userGuidance == AUTHORED })
                fixture.save(ScreenId.BATCH_EDITOR, null, "save-batch", mapOf("recipeId" to recipe.id.value,
                    "trayId" to tray.id.value, "substrate" to AUTHORED, "actualSeedMassGrams" to "12.5",
                    "plannedSowDate" to "2026-10-10", "supplier" to AUTHORED, "cultivar" to AUTHORED, "seedLot" to AUTHORED))
                val batch = fixture.database.snapshot().batches.single()
                fixture.save(ScreenId.OBSERVATION_EDITOR, batch.id.value, "save-observation", mapOf("text" to AUTHORED))
                fixture.save(ScreenId.CLOSE_BATCH, batch.id.value, "save-outcome", mapOf("outcome" to "failed",
                    "reason" to AUTHORED, "note" to " \t\n "))
                val snapshot = fixture.database.snapshot()
                val saved = snapshot.batches.single()
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, saved.substrateSnapshot)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, saved.supplier)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, saved.cultivar)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, saved.seedLot)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, (saved.outcome as BatchOutcome.Failed).reason)
                assertEquals(" \t\n ", saved.outcome?.note)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, snapshot.observations.single().text)
                val codec = LocalBackupArchiveCodec()
                assertEquals(snapshot, codec.decode(codec.encode(LocalBackupArchive(snapshot, emptyList()))).snapshot)
                snapshot
            }
            Fixture(url, false).use { reopened ->
                assertEquals(original, reopened.database.snapshot())
                reopened.root.open(ScreenId.RECIPE, original.recipes.single().id.value)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, reopened.field("name"))
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, reopened.field("stage1Guidance"))
                reopened.root.open(ScreenId.OBSERVATION_EDITOR, original.observations.single().id.value)
                assertEquals(AUTHORED, reopened.field("text"))
            }
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun actualHarvestMassIsVisibleAfterReopenAndMissingMeasurementStaysEmpty() = runTest {
        suspend fun assertMeasurement(fixture: Fixture, expected: Double?) {

    @Test
    fun previewPassesThroughProductionWrappersWithoutReminderReconciliation() = runTest {
        val command = ScreenCommand("confirm-stage", "batch", mapOf("nextState" to "light_growth"))
        val expected = com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.component.StageChangeProjection(command, emptyList())
        var mutations = 0
        val delegate = object : ScreenDataManager {
            override fun watch(screen: ScreenId, stableId: String?) = flowOf(ScreenSnapshot())
            override suspend fun previewStage(command: ScreenCommand) = Result.success(expected)
            override suspend fun execute(screen: ScreenId, command: ScreenCommand): Result<ScreenSnapshot> {
                mutations += 1
                return Result.success(ScreenSnapshot())
            }
        }
        val reasons = mutableListOf<ReconciliationReason>()
        val wrapped = CrashAwareScreenDataManager(ReminderAwareScreenDataManager(delegate,
            FakeSettings(ProductPreferences()), FakeNotificationPermissionService(PermissionState.Granted), reasons::add),
            MutableStateFlow(com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.platform.CrashReportingState.Active(true)))
        assertEquals(expected, wrapped.previewStage(command).getOrThrow())
        assertEquals(0, mutations)
        assertTrue(reasons.isEmpty())
    }

/** Loads generated production resources through Compose's Android reader and system-locale resolver. */
class LocaleResourceResolutionTest {
    @get:Rule
    val paparazzi = Paparazzi(
        environment = detectEnvironment().copy(compileSdkVersion = 37),
        deviceConfig = DeviceConfig.PIXEL_5,
    )

    @Test
    fun systemLocaleChangesSelectRussianAndUnsupportedLocaleFallsBackToEnglish() = runTest {
        paparazzi.configureComposeResources()
        val previous = Locale.getDefault()
        val previousDisplay = Locale.getDefault(Locale.Category.DISPLAY)
        val previousFormat = Locale.getDefault(Locale.Category.FORMAT)
        val privacy = typedPreviewState(UiScreen.ADVERTISING_PRIVACY)
        val consentKeys = ConsentChoice.entries.map { choice -> requireNotNull(privacy
            .withAdvertisingPrivacy(previewPrivacy(choice), PREVIEW_PRIVACY_NOW).items.single { it.id == "privacy" }.stateKey) }
        val keys = listOf("nav_today", SproutPaceCatalog.cultures.single { it.id.value == "radish" }.nameKey.value,
            "privacy_heading") + consentKeys
        suspend fun resolve(languageTag: String): List<String> {
            Locale.setDefault(Locale.forLanguageTag(languageTag))
            return keys.map { getString(strictTextResource(it)) }
        }
        try {
            val english = resolve("en-US")
            assertEquals(listOf("Today", "Radish", "Your advertising choice", "Not decided", "Accepted", "Declined", "Withdrawn"), english)
            val russian = resolve("ru-RU")
            assertEquals(listOf("�������", "�����", "��� �롮� ४����", "�롮� �� ᤥ���", "�ਭ��", "�⪫�����", "�⮧����"), russian)
            assertEquals(english, resolve("de-DE"))
            assertEquals(english, resolve("en-GB"))
            assertEquals(russian, resolve("ru-KZ"))
            assertEquals(english, resolve("en-US"))
        } finally {
            Locale.setDefault(previous)
            Locale.setDefault(Locale.Category.DISPLAY, previousDisplay)
            Locale.setDefault(Locale.Category.FORMAT, previousFormat)
        }
    }

    @Test
    fun nativeNotificationResourcesFollowConfigurationAndFallBackToEnglish() {
        fun resolve(languageTag: String): String {
            paparazzi.unsafeUpdateConfig(deviceConfig = DeviceConfig.PIXEL_5.copy(locale = languageTag.replace("-", "-r")))
            return paparazzi.context.getString(com.sedsoftware.sproutpace.platform.R.string.notification_soak_complete_title)
        }
        assertEquals("Soaking is complete", resolve("en-US"))
        assertEquals("����稢���� �����襭�", resolve("ru-RU"))
        assertEquals("Soaking is complete", resolve("de-DE"))
        assertEquals("����稢���� �����襭�", resolve("ru-KZ"))
        assertEquals("Soaking is complete", resolve("en-US"))
    }
}
